methodology.actual_attitude: log.state rows 7:9 (MATLAB indexing), aligned to log.transition_time for 20000 transitions; full 20001 state samples used to reproduce root task SO3 metric
methodology.raw_outer: log.raw_outer_attitude; per-run position-loop output, not the fixed task reference
methodology.angles: same ZYX quaternion geodesic formula as v3 raw audit; per-axis errors are wrapped Euler coordinate differences in [-pi,pi)
methodology.time_windows: [0,5) s and [15,20) s, using the 20000 transition samples
methodology.reported_pairs: fixed task→raw outer; raw outer→filtered; filtered→actual; fixed task→actual total; each independently computed; SO3 angles are never summed
methodology.causal_scope: cross-method differences are descriptive only because closed-loop state traces differ; no single-component causal claim is made
methodology.inertia_reconstruction: not used; no inertia data or reconstruction inputs were read

full_transition_window.range_convention: all 20000 transition samples; final state sample separately used for root task metric
